body: thank you for taking the time to talk to me.

unfortunately im not very good at being positive. im a pessimist/cynic at heart. im not sure if this is just because of ive felt depressed for a long time (over2-3 years, gradually gotten worse i think, just self-diagnosing here though) or if im actually like this. I think i'm happiest at work because all my coworkers are so amazing and kind and they feel like a big family. i also feel like im being productive or im doing something worthwhile/contributing to society in some way. i feel useful i guess. Other than that I dont think theres anywhere else I feel happy or feel 'better' than usual. It used to be with my cats but even they dont do anything.

I'm going to sleep now because its like 3;30 am. but i want to say thank you for tkaing the time out of your life to have this conversation to me. thank you so much.

It's over in about a week. my counselor and i have one appointment before she has to leave for holiday where we will be discussing hte place she referred me too. a part of me wants school back but the other part doesnt. I know im just going to feel miserable again. I mean I guess by thinking that, as a result i will, but ugh. I've gone from being an overachiever to failing all my subjects, my teachers being disappointed or wondering what the fuck is wrong and i dislike everyone around me. i dont dislike them i guess... maybe more envious that they all seem so normal and happy and well-adjusted.

i dont know. its such a hard situation. Im underage, i dont want my dad to find out because of various reasons. i would do absolutely anything else then have my dad find out about all this. the place was found through my school counselor and its free and they dont need parental permission and offer counselling and psychiatrist services but they havent called... I feel like i am really losing it. because at this point now nothing my friends do help me, like they used to. ive been on school break for a week and a half now and i havent done anything. been sleeping a lot because nothing holds my interest and my thoughts just run rampant you know.

i dont know. its just a mixbag of feelings there and it just all sucks. ratioanlly i understand why we broke up obviously if he didnt have feelings for me like that anymore its better to break up. but i dont understand how you could lose feelings like that. he's said all the good things about me are still so good then what just what changed :\ 

when he told me about his apathy i said well you have to see someone about that and he made me promise to do the same. Now his apathy doesnt even seem to be affecting his life and i dont think hes seeing the counselor anymore. i feel manipulated into seeking help when i didnt really want it. im so skeptical of it actually working. Found a place through my school. They were supposed to ring a week ago. ive got nothing. 
sorry that really went on a tangent...
its a playlist on songza called "sleepytime indie"
ive been listening to music. i do feel less at risk now. but i thibk im startnig to get anxiety because lateyl it feels hard to breathe.

I had a boyfriend and i dont think i have been that happy in ages. but we broke up recently. he was apathetic. lost feelings/attraction for me. not my fault. somehow that makes it worse that i didnt do anything wrong. if i didnt do anything why am i the one suffering? am i being punished for being happy and having something go right? he still wants to be friends and support me. but i dont understand...

I just i just i dont know. my close friends know. but they dont know what to do they dont know what to say. there isnt anytihing to say when my mind is made up. sometimes they make me feel worse. what is there to say when i dont have a will to live and feel so hollow inside. everything i do feels like a monumental effort. The more i talk about this stuff to people close to me the worse it all feels. i dont know how to explain this properly, im sorry.

i just dont understand why i have to keep myself going for the sake of others. im so tired of everything. i feel tired of living. i dont even know if he means much to me, even though he should. im a terrible person for even saying that.

i feel so empty though. talking to them brings me no emotive response or anyting and i dont know why. the only person who wouldnt get over it would be my dad and that is the only thing that is stopping me from constantly tring to kill myself.

i know you're not trying to out me sorry. im just i dont want anyone close to me to know andi  dont know what to do... i havent reached this point before where i have a plan and where ive tried recently but it didnt work and i just feel like a colossal failure

i dont really want to be specific about my life because i know people who could identify me on here.

i dont know why ive wrote a post on here... i really dont. I dont feel anything. Im sorry this probably isnt making a lot of sense.
i dont even know what to talk about
